expensiveChecks: desktop and mobile public browser verification for affected routes
desktop and mobile authenticated route verification for affected workspaces
exact record-count, idempotency, duplicate, backup, and rollback verification
resumable small-batch generation with cursor and exact final counts
controlled workflow run with machine-readable PASS/HOLD evidence
executionRules: Run fast checks before expensive or live checks.
Use one integrated branch, one pull request, and one authoritative workflow per production target.
Inspect the first failing stage before rerunning.
Rerun only the failed or affected scope when inputs are unchanged.
After the same failure twice, change the execution design instead of repeating the pipeline.
Preserve the live system and external-action locks when verification is HOLD.
